# Template: nephron
The nephron, the kidney's working unit, drawn as the classic schematic: glomerulus in Bowman's capsule (with afferent/efferent arterioles), the convoluted proximal tubule, the hairpin loop of Henle (descending and ascending limbs), the distal tubule and the collecting duct ending in urine — with labeled reabsorption/secretion arrows per segment (glucose, sodium, water...), an optional medullary osmolarity gradient wash, and a highlight_segment option to light up where a drug or process acts (e.g. loop diuretics on the ascending limb). Choose this scene for ANY request about the nephron or kidney function, glomerular filtration, tubular reabsorption or secretion, the loop of Henle, collecting duct and ADH, where diuretics act, or how urine is formed.

{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {

     },

      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
       "proximal",
       "descending",

      ]
     },

      "description": "out = reabsorbed back to blood (default); in = secreted into the tubule."
     }
    },
    "required": [

   },
   "description": "Substance arrows per segment (capacity: proximal 3, distal 2, collecting 2, limbs 1 each). Default: the textbook set (glucose/Na⁺/H₂O proximal, H₂O descending, Na⁺Cl⁻ ascending, Na⁺ distal, H₂O collecting)."
  },
  "highlight_segment": {
   "type": "string",

   ],

  },
  "show_gradient": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Medullary osmolarity gradient wash behind the loop of Henle (default false)."
  },
  "labels": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Part names (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- capsule: Bowman's capsule (the cup)
- glomerulus: the capillary tuft inside it
- afferent: arteriole arrow into the glomerulus
- efferent: arteriole arrow out of it
- proximal: the proximal convoluted tubule
- descending: the descending limb of the loop of Henle
- ascending: the ascending limb
- distal: the distal convoluted tubule
- collecting: the collecting duct
- urine_arrow: the outflow arrow at the bottom of the duct
- gradient: the osmolarity wash (a group, when show_gradient)
- arrow_<i>: transport arrow i with its species text (a group)
- label_glom: part name captions (when labels; likewise label_proximal, label_henle, label_distal, label_collecting, label_urine)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a nephron showing what is reabsorbed in each segment." → params: {"title":"The nephron"}
Request: "Show where loop diuretics act in the nephron." → params: {"highlight_segment":"ascending","title":"Where furosemide works"}

In YAML: `template: nephron` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
